Which statement about graphite is correct?
A
It has a low melting point because it has a simple molecular structure.
B
It has a high melting point because it has a giant ionic structure.
C
It has a low melting point because it has weak forces of attraction between layers of atoms.
D
It has a high melting point because it has a giant covalent structure.

options.label: A
options.text: It has a low melting point because it has a simple molecular structure.

options.label: B
options.text: It has a high melting point because it has a giant ionic structure.

options.label: C
options.text: It has a low melting point because it has weak forces of attraction between layers of atoms.

options.label: D
options.text: It has a high melting point because it has a giant covalent structure.
